correctness.rationale: All \(2^{16}\) \(\mathbb F_2\)-linear endomorphisms are exhaustively tested. Bilinearity of the Rota-Baxter defect makes the 16 ordered basis pairs sufficient. A separately written tuple-coordinate implementation rechecks all 80 accepted maps on all 256 element pairs. All invertible unital multiplicative maps are separately enumerated, giving 24 automorphisms, and conjugation gives exactly 12 stable orbits with the stated sizes. The verifier also checks the rank distribution and \(R(z)=0\) for every solution.

value.rationale: Characteristic two is a mathematically motivated boundary because the exterior sign collapses, so this is not a routine substitution into characteristic-not-two formulas. The theorem completely resolves the smallest nontrivial exterior algebra over the smallest field, and the orbit reduction from 80 maps to 12 canonical classes supplies compact reusable classification data. The universal kernel \(R(z)=0\) and rank profile give structural information beyond a raw count.
